lines: Limits? Fine, shall I give it a try?
I'm not idle enough to throw away love—always all right, all right
Once we get past this, there's only relief ahead
the throbbing in my chest won't fade
Shield yourself with a hardened shell
I keep looking for reasons to give up

Even if I realize I'm alone
Sometimes is fine, occasional is enough

I want you to share your happiness
Fine, enough—wish it was from the start
Baby, becoming an adult isn't the point
It's okay if I can't win
I want the strength that never loses—yeah, all right, all right
Even on days when misfortune's arrow won't leave, all right, all right
because a day to laugh will come
Baby, we won't become adults, but
Baby, we won't become adults, but
